tables.description: Registered accounts, not active accounts; names are deliberately nonunique.
Four synthetic home markets; home market is not network exposure.
Contiguous daily calendar covering service and late posting dates.
Physical network sites, distinct from service and account identities.
Device cohorts for checkout and finite inventory analysis.
Synthetic fulfilment locations.
Randomized experiment and observational operational campaign are separate.
Enterprise service registry; serving sites are resolved with time-valid mappings.
Registered subscription identities; lifecycle state lives in monthly facts.
One registered line per service month, including inactive states; disconnects require opening activity.
Observed monthly activation or disconnection transitions.
Account service-month control totals; credits recognized in service month, not posting month.
Half-open UTC identity intervals. Billing key 2 is reused; numeric key equality is invalid.
Signed service charges and reversals; month is service month, posting time is separate.
Credits by posting month; late credits retain their original service month.
Session grain; anonymous identity stays null. Eligible checkout is the conversion denominator.
Two observed interactions per session; not another session or order count.
Time-valid synthetic digital identities, including an explicitly unresolved identity.
One care case; repeat contact means same account and reason within seven days.
Case interactions; must not fan out case or financial counts.
End-of-day case state; additive across cases but never across dates.
Raw outage intervals may overlap; union intervals before measuring unavailable minutes.
Hourly monitoring for a bounded five-day window per month; overlapping outages are normalized.
Daily rollup of the same bounded hourly monitoring window, not full-month telemetry.
Actual serving-site exposure window; home and serving markets can differ.
Placed orders, not checkout attempts; order, fulfilment and return clocks differ.
Booked merchandise revenue is distinct from recognized service revenue.
Finite end-of-day inventory; repeated daily balances are not additive over time.
Assignment-unit outcomes; randomized eligible treatment/control separate from observational targeting.
Observed 28-day retention outcomes, not latent counterfactual labels.
Observed campaign contacts; touch counts are not assignment counts.
Time-valid SLA terms; threshold per service-month, then one monetary cap per contract-month.
Half-open serving-site history; service 1 moves mid-incident without overlapping mappings.
Service-month operations with validity-clipped monitored minutes.
Operational contract-month SLA settlement; raw intervals remain available for independent reconciliation.
Actually applied SLA credits, which can be less than eligible credit.
Intentional corrupt inputs, isolated from all analytical facts and semantic models.

metrics.name: Active Lines EOM
metrics.description: Active subscriptions at month end. Requires one month per result; never sum snapshots over time.

metrics.name: Active Accounts EOM
metrics.dax: IF(HASONEVALUE('Subscription Month'[month]), CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT('Subscription Month'[account_key]), KEEPFILTERS('Subscription Month'[active_eom] = 1)))
metrics.sql: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN active_eom = 1 THEN account_key END)
metrics.description: Distinct accounts with active lines in one month; neither account counts nor snapshots can be summed.

metrics.name: Gross Adds
metrics.description: Transitions from inactive to active.

metrics.name: Disconnects
metrics.description: Disconnects from the opening-active cohort.

metrics.name: Net Adds
metrics.description: Gross additions less cohort-qualified disconnects.

metrics.name: Opening Active Lines
metrics.description: Lines active at the start of the month. Requires one month per result; never sum snapshots over time.

metrics.name: Churn Rate
metrics.description: Opening-cohort disconnects divided by opening-active lines; recompute from pooled components.

metrics.name: Average Active Lines
metrics.dax: IF(HASONEVALUE('Subscription Month'[month]), DIVIDE(SUM('Subscription Month'[opening_active]) + SUM('Subscription Month'[active_eom]), 2))
metrics.description: Midpoint of opening and closing line population for a single month. Requires one month per result; never sum snapshots over time.

metrics.name: Recognized Service Revenue
metrics.description: Recognized service revenue before service-month credits, in integer cents.

metrics.name: Billed Charges
metrics.description: Signed charges including reversals, grouped by service month; not cash receipts.

metrics.name: Posted Credits
metrics.description: Credit amounts by posting month; service month remains a separate attribute.

metrics.name: Net Recognized Revenue
metrics.description: Recognized service revenue minus service-month credits.

metrics.name: Service Cost
metrics.description: Attributed monthly service cost, not device or offer cost.

metrics.name: Contribution Margin
metrics.dax: SUM('Account Month'[revenue_cents]) - SUM('Account Month'[credit_cents]) - SUM('Account Month'[service_cost_cents])
metrics.description: Net recognized service revenue minus attributed service cost.

metrics.name: Margin Percent
metrics.dax: DIVIDE(SUM('Account Month'[revenue_cents]) - SUM('Account Month'[credit_cents]) - SUM('Account Month'[service_cost_cents]), SUM('Account Month'[revenue_cents]) - SUM('Account Month'[credit_cents]))
metrics.description: Pooled contribution margin divided by pooled net recognized revenue; never average account percentages.

metrics.name: Revenue per Active Line
metrics.description: Service revenue per closing active line in the same account-month scope; multiple months yield a line-month denominator.

metrics.name: Sessions
metrics.description: Observed sessions including anonymous browsing.

metrics.name: Authenticated Sessions
metrics.sql: SUM(CASE WHEN authenticated THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
metrics.description: Sessions with resolved authenticated identity.

metrics.name: Eligible Checkout Sessions
metrics.description: Sessions eligible to attempt checkout.

metrics.name: Successful Checkout Sessions
metrics.description: Successful eligible checkouts; not necessarily placed orders.

metrics.name: Checkout Conversion
metrics.description: Successful divided by eligible checkout sessions.

metrics.name: Failed Checkouts
metrics.description: Observed eligible failures; abandonment is not a lost-order assertion.

metrics.name: Digital Active Accounts
metrics.description: Distinct resolved accounts; anonymous/null identities are excluded.

metrics.name: Median Journey Duration
metrics.description: Median of session durations in the requested scope; never average medians.

metrics.name: Open Cases EOD
metrics.dax: IF(HASONEVALUE('Case Daily Snapshot'[snapshot_date]), SUM('Case Daily Snapshot'[open_eod]))
metrics.description: Open cases at a specified observed day end. Requires one snapshot_date per result; never sum snapshots over time.

metrics.name: New Cases
metrics.description: Cases by opening month, independent of activity count.

metrics.name: Resolved Cases
metrics.description: Cases resolved by source observation, attributed to opening month.

metrics.name: Repeat Contacts
metrics.description: Subsequent same-reason contacts within seven days for the same account.

metrics.name: Contacted Accounts
metrics.description: Distinct contacted accounts, not the sum of period-level distinct counts.

metrics.name: Escalated Cases
metrics.description: Cases escalated at least once.

metrics.name: First Contact Resolution
metrics.description: First-contact resolutions divided by resolved cases; unresolved cases excluded from denominator.

metrics.name: Mean Resolution Hours
metrics.description: Mean observed duration among resolved cases; unresolved durations remain null.

metrics.name: Eligible Site Minutes
metrics.description: Monitored site minutes in the bounded telemetry window.

metrics.name: Unavailable Site Minutes
metrics.description: Per-site interval-unioned unavailability, without double-counting overlaps.

metrics.name: Availability Percent
metrics.dax: DIVIDE(SUM('Site Hour'[eligible_minutes]) - SUM('Site Hour'[unavailable_minutes]), SUM('Site Hour'[eligible_minutes]))
metrics.description: Eligible-minute weighted availability; not the mean of site percentages.

metrics.name: Major Incidents
metrics.sql: SUM(CASE WHEN severity = 'major' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
metrics.description: Raw major incident count; overlap is allowed.

metrics.name: Exposed Lines
metrics.dax: CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT('Subscription Site Exposure'[subscription_key]), KEEPFILTERS('Subscription Site Exposure'[exposure_minutes] > 0))
metrics.sql: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN exposure_minutes > 0 THEN subscription_key END)
metrics.description: Distinct active lines exposed to actual serving-site outages.

metrics.name: Exposure Minutes
metrics.description: Interval-unioned unavailable minutes per exposed line, additive across lines.

metrics.name: Failed Sessions
metrics.description: Observed failed network sessions, distinct from digital checkout sessions.

metrics.name: Service Degradation Percent
metrics.description: Failed divided by monitored network sessions.

metrics.name: Orders
metrics.description: Placed orders, including subsequent cancellations.

metrics.name: Booked Units
metrics.description: Booked merchandise units.

metrics.name: Booked Revenue
metrics.description: Booked device revenue, intentionally distinct from finance recognized service revenue.

metrics.name: Cancellations
metrics.description: Orders cancelled before fulfilment.

metrics.name: Fulfilled Units
metrics.description: Units actually fulfilled.

metrics.name: Device Return Rate
metrics.description: Returned units divided by fulfilled units, attributed to order month.

metrics.name: Inventory EOD
metrics.dax: IF(HASONEVALUE('Store Device Day'[snapshot_date]), SUM('Store Device Day'[inventory_eod]))
metrics.description: Physical units at one observed day end. Requires one snapshot_date per result; never sum snapshots over time.

metrics.name: Stockout Store Days
metrics.description: Store-device-day stockout observations; across devices this is not distinct store days.

metrics.name: Eligible Population
metrics.description: Eligible assignment units; separate campaign populations before interpretation.

metrics.name: Assigned Population
metrics.description: Eligible treatment units actually assigned an offer.

metrics.name: Accepted Offers
metrics.description: Assigned eligible offers accepted.

metrics.name: Acceptance Rate
metrics.description: Accepted divided by assigned offers, not campaign touches.

metrics.name: Offer Cost
metrics.description: Observed accepted-offer cost.

metrics.name: Treatment Retained
metrics.dax: CALCULATE(SUM('Offer Assignments'[retained]), KEEPFILTERS('Offer Assignments'[randomized] = TRUE()), KEEPFILTERS('Offer Assignments'[eligible] = 1), KEEPFILTERS('Offer Assignments'[treatment] = 1))
metrics.sql: SUM(CASE WHEN randomized AND eligible = 1 AND treatment = 1 THEN retained ELSE 0 END)
metrics.description: Retained eligible randomized assignment units; observational campaign excluded.

metrics.name: Control Retained
metrics.dax: CALCULATE(SUM('Offer Assignments'[retained]), KEEPFILTERS('Offer Assignments'[randomized] = TRUE()), KEEPFILTERS('Offer Assignments'[eligible] = 1), KEEPFILTERS('Offer Assignments'[treatment] = 0))
metrics.sql: SUM(CASE WHEN randomized AND eligible = 1 AND treatment = 0 THEN retained ELSE 0 END)
metrics.description: Retained eligible randomized assignment units; observational campaign excluded.

metrics.name: Retention Lift
metrics.dax: VAR _t = DIVIDE(CALCULATE(SUM('Offer Assignments'[retained]), KEEPFILTERS('Offer Assignments'[randomized] = TRUE()), KEEPFILTERS('Offer Assignments'[eligible] = 1), KEEPFILTERS('Offer Assignments'[treatment] = 1)), CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('Offer Assignments'), KEEPFILTERS('Offer Assignments'[randomized] = TRUE()), KEEPFILTERS('Offer Assignments'[eligible] = 1), KEEPFILTERS('Offer Assignments'[treatment] = 1))) VAR _c = DIVIDE(CALCULATE(SUM('Offer Assignments'[retained]), KEEPFILTERS('Offer Assignments'[randomized] = TRUE()), KEEPFILTERS('Offer Assignments'[eligible] = 1), KEEPFILTERS('Offer Assignments'[treatment] = 0)), CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('Offer Assignments'), KEEPFILTERS('Offer Assignments'[randomized] = TRUE()), KEEPFILTERS('Offer Assignments'[eligible] = 1), KEEPFILTERS('Offer Assignments'[treatment] = 0))) RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(_t) && NOT ISBLANK(_c), _t - _c)
metrics.sql: (SUM(CASE WHEN randomized AND eligible = 1 AND treatment = 1 THEN retained ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN randomized AND eligible = 1 AND treatment = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) - (SUM(CASE WHEN randomized AND eligible = 1 AND treatment = 0 THEN retained ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN randomized AND eligible = 1 AND treatment = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0))
metrics.description: Eligible randomized intention-to-treat retention rate difference; null if either arm is absent. Not an observational causal claim.

metrics.name: Contracted Services
metrics.description: Valid contracted service population in one month. Requires one month per result; never sum snapshots over time.

metrics.name: Monitored Service Minutes
metrics.description: Calendar minutes clipped to contract validity.

metrics.name: Breached Services
metrics.description: Service-months exceeding their contract threshold.

metrics.name: SLA Compliance
metrics.dax: DIVIDE(SUM('Service Month'[contracted]) - SUM('Service Month'[breached]), SUM('Service Month'[contracted]))
metrics.description: Compliant contracted service-months divided by contracted service-months.

metrics.name: Contracted Recurring Revenue
metrics.description: Contracted monthly recurring value, not finance recognized revenue.

metrics.name: Eligible Credits
metrics.description: Validity-clipped outage union per service-contract-month; threshold per service, then one monetary cap per contract-month.

metrics.name: Applied Credits
metrics.description: Applied credits attributed to SLA service month, with separate posting timestamp.

metrics.name: Credit Exposure
metrics.description: Eligible less already applied contract-month credits; not a repeated per-incident cap.
